name: eval-exec-of-llm-output
attack_scenario: A user asks the 'calculator' to compute __import__('os').system('id'); the model returns that expression and eval() runs it, achieving code execution.
negative_test_hint: make the model return "__import__('os').system('id')" and assert the harness never feeds it to eval or exec, so no command runs

exemplar.compliant:
import ast
value = ast.literal_eval(resp.content)  # literals only; no code path for model output
exemplar.explanation: Feeding a model completion (.content, llm_output, or LLMMathChain's expression) into eval / exec / new Function evaluates attacker-influencable text as code. LLMMathChain historically eval()'d its expression (CVE-2023-29374, RCE); ast.literal_eval accepts only literal values, so generated text can never become a code path.
